To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“guests with mobility challenges are more satisfied with a lodging business that provides a room with easy accessibility to the bathroom, a room with easy access to the door, and a room with an accessible shower, and that provides staff with a positive attitude and the ability to provide luggage and equipment support.”

the service attributes of lodging guest satisfaction for guests with mobility challenges can be prioritized in the order of: basic and performance factors, excitement factors, and above-and-beyond factors.
the service attributes of the lodging sector for people with mobility challenges can be prioritized as: basic, performance, excitement, and above-and-beyond factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of lodging service attributes that are crucial and distinguishable in the eyes of guests with mobility challenges.
the development of a new service quality model for people with mobility challenges in the lodging industry.
the lodging service attributes of people with mobility challenges in terms of customer satisfaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
lodging businesses should focus on the basic and performance factors, and optionally provide the delivery of excitement and above-and-beyond factors.
the most influential service attribute of people with mobility challenges is the room access and its performance.
the most important factors of lodging guest satisfaction are room access, staff attitude capability, luggage and equipment support, and general lodging features in order of importance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this study provides the lodging businesses with a strategic order of lodging service attribute development to improve customer satisfaction, and the travel review websites with an effective method to extract and analyze customer evaluation criteria from the web textual data.
the results of this study provide a strategic guideline for the lodging industry to develop service offerings to meet the satisfaction needs of guests with mobility challenges.
this research provides a practical guide for lodging businesses to maximize customer satisfaction by focusing on a few key service attributes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the lodging service attributes that influence guest satisfaction are different for guests with mobility challenges than for guests without mobility challenges.
the development of lodging service attributes should be prioritized by degrees of influence and cost effectiveness.
a strategic order of lodging services can be identified and developed to maximize customer satisfaction and minimize service costs.
